summary: Frontend test of the M-Box order announcements (Auftrags-Durchsagen). The admin route /orders/999901 shows 'Auftrag nicht gefunden' because /api/orders/epirent/999901 returns 404, and OrderDetailPage returns early on that error. As a result the M-Box tile cannot be reached for the test order (blocker, as expected). Workaround: tested the admin customer search (KundenFreigabe) on the real order /orders/33. The full OrderAudioPanel/timer flow (the same component) was tested as customer on /durchsagen, on desktop 1920 and on mobile 390x844. Everything requested works except one countdown bug after Stopp. All test files and timers were deleted afterwards (999901 only has the existing 'Evakuierung' left, 0 timers).

ui_bugs.issue: The countdown setInterval from play() is never cleared by stop(). Stop sets countdown=null, but the next tick sets it again, so the button 'Start in 4 s – abbrechen' (order-audio-stop-all) reappears about 1 s after Stopp and counts down to 0. Reproduced: Einmal abspielen -> Stopp -> after 0.7 s the button is gone, after 1.4 s it is back with 'Start in 4 s'. Several plays in a row also start several parallel intervals, and there is no cleanup on unmount. Fix: keep the interval in a useRef, clear it in stop()/before a new play()/in the useEffect cleanup.

integration_issues.flow: Admin order detail for test order 999901
integration_issues.issue: /orders/999901 renders the error page 'Auftrag nicht gefunden' (the EpiRent call returns 404, and OrderDetailPage returns early at `if (error)`). The M-Box tile (tile-mbox / mbox-order-section) is therefore not reachable in the admin UI for orders that only exist in orders_cache/mbox. Admin flows on 999901 (chips with a real mast, play/loop/timer as admin) could not be run in the admin UI; they were verified through the same component on the customer page. If needed: on an EpiRent 404, fall back to orders_cache or still render the M-Box tile.

issues: order-audio-inactive always says 'Diese Veranstaltung liegt noch vor Ihnen', even for past orders (order 33: dispo 05.06.–17.06.2026, today is Oct 2026). For past orders it needs its own text, e.g. 'Veranstaltung beendet'.
The address line is truncated after 'Neu…' and the date range wraps to its own two lines next to it, which looks a bit uneven. Better: address and dates on separate lines.
Minor: on first render, before the data loads, the chip area shows 'Aktuell kein Mast zugewiesen.' for a moment (data=null is treated like devices=[]). A loading state would be cleaner.

action_items: OrderAudioPanel: clear the countdown interval in stop(), on a new play() and on unmount (useRef), otherwise the countdown/stop-all button comes back after Stopp
OrderDetailPage: on an EpiRent 404, still allow the M-Box tile for orders from orders_cache (otherwise test order 999901 and similar orders cannot be managed as admin)
Inactive banner: use separate wording for past orders vs. upcoming ones
critical_code_review_comments: OrderAudioPanel.play: the setInterval handle is not stored, so there is no clearInterval in stop/unmount and multiple clicks start parallel intervals
MastAuswahl: with only one mast, a click on that mast does nothing visible (it falls back to 'Alle'). This works as specified but gives the user no feedback
TimerForm: no client-side check for a date in the past in mode 'Einmalig' (relies on the backend)
OrderAudioPanel: data=null before the first load renders 'kein Mast zugewiesen', so there is no loading state

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested checks pass except the countdown-after-stop bug; admin route 999901 blocked)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Uploaded files 'QA UI Test' and 'QA Kunde Handy' plus 2 timers on 999901 were created and deleted again.

Customer kunde.meier@test.com sees 999901 (läuft, mast MBOX-TEST-1 offline -> toast 'Offline: ...' is expected) and 999902 (ab 01.03.2027 bedienbar, no files). Tested and OK: customer search meier/TM-4711/xyzxyz (nohit), chips (single mast falls back to Alle), upload -> 'bereit · 0 dB' within about 5-10 s, play/loop/stop toasts, stop-all countdown, timers (18:30 Fr, Sa loop; toggle -> opacity-60 and hint 0 aktive; run-now toast 'Timer-Test'; one-off timer 'am 01.06.2027'; delete), file delete with confirm, mobile 390: hub tile module-durchsagen, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390).
rca of the issue: Countdown: in OrderAudioPanel.play() `const t = setInterval(...)` is a local variable; stop() only calls setCountdown(null), and the still-running interval keeps setting s-1. Admin 999901: OrderDetailPage.fetchOrder -> GET /orders/epirent/999901 returns 404 -> setError -> early return of the error view before the tab hub.
